mug_priya: Pattern: I guessed cupboard_k1 at 08:13 and 14:52 on day 14. Reality: It was at kitchen_table_k1 in the morning and coffee_table_l1 in the afternoon. Next time: This item rotates between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Do not default to cupboard_k1. Check kitchen_table_k1 for morning queries and coffee_table_l1 for afternoon/evening queries.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I guessed dish_rack_k1 at 13:49, kitchen_table_k1 at 18:01, and coffee_table_l1 at 21:29 on day 14. Reality: It was at coffee_table_l1 at 13:49 and 18:01, and counter_k1 at 21:29. Next time: This item strongly favors coffee_table_l1 during the day and early evening. For late-night queries (after 21:00), prioritize counter_k1. Do not default to dish_rack_k1 or kitchen_table_k1.

glass_priya: Pattern: I guessed nightstand_b1 at 21:42 on day 14. Reality: It was at counter_k1. Next time: Do not guess bedroom spots (nightstand_b1) for this item. It is frequently found in the kitchen (counter_k1, cupboard_k1) or living room (coffee_table_l1). Prioritize counter_k1 for late-night queries.

General Note: Avoid rigid location rules for mug_priya, water_bottle_priya, and glass_priya. These items move frequently between kitchen and living areas. For mug_priya, valid spots are kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. For water_bottle_priya, coffee_table_l1 is dominant for day/evening, while counter_k1 is likely for late night. For glass_priya, counter_k1 is a strong candidate for late night. Always prioritize recent specific evidence, but recognize that "recent" may be from a different day if the item rotates. Do not default to bedroom spots (desk_b1, nightstand_b1) for these items unless there is specific evidence.
